rules.content:
/*
Dark Angels ransomware
*/

rule DarkAngels_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.darkangels"
        description = "Detects Dark Angels ransomware ransom note"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $s1 = "Dark Angels" ascii nocase
        $s2 = "DarkAngels" ascii nocase
        $s3 = "darkangels.onion" ascii nocase
        $s4 = "DARKANGELS" ascii

    condition:
        any of them
}
